sample_unit: nurse managers (census) and repeated model responses to simulated ethical scenarios
models_evaluated: three generative AI models (unnamed in abstract)

links.outcome: Within-model response stability across repeated runs of identical scenarios
links.effect: Two models were highly stable and the third varied more across repetitions.
links.quote: Overall concordance was similar, although two models were highly stable and the third varied more across repetitions.

unlisted_practices: Repeated evaluation of generative AI responses rather than single response for ethical decision-making
Comparing AI ethical decisions against professional nurse manager preferences

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM concordance and response stability compared to nurse managers on ethical decision-making scenarios without testing a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
